name: SpongeBob vs. EvilBob
summary: The main character is a character named SpongeBob SquarePants. He lives in a pineapple-house, along with a snail named Gary. They broke the quiet life of the noise in the city center. When he came to the city Sponge Bob saw his evil clone, whom he thought had destroyed. To drive him out of town for good, he needs to overtake him on a motorcycle.
